versions.localizedDescription:
v1.12.1•303
Beta 4

BookOrbit
• New • Send to E•Reader: email a book to your Kindle or other e•reader from its details. Your devices, groups, templates and send history are under Send by email in your account in Settings, and admins set up mail servers in Server admin
• New • Quick Match several books at once from the library's select mode, like on Audiobookshelf
• New • Request books missing from your series, from Find Missing Books or the Scan Series results, if your account can make requests
• New • Tab hold shortcuts include BookOrbit's admin pages
• Fix • Resetting a book takes it out of Currently Reading and clears its ebook spot, books you only read can be reset, and you can set a book back to Unread

Read along
• New • Create a read along from a book's File info on BookOrbit 3.6 servers that have the read along worker, and get a notification when it's ready
• New • A BookOrbit read along that sits beside the audiobook is the copy the reader opens, so read along follows the audiobook

Chapter editor
• New • On BookOrbit 3.6, get chapters from the audio files, the ebook, the read along or an earlier version, write them into the audio files and protect them from rescans

File info
• New • Delete a single file from a book, if your account can delete
• New • Request the other format on BookOrbit: ask for the ebook of an audiobook or the audiobook of an ebook

Audiobookshelf 2.37
• Fix • Live updates keep working after your sign•in token runs out
• New • Matching a book offers Explicit and Abridged when the result has them
• Fix • With libraries merged, a series from another library loads on the Absorbing screen

Reader
• Fix • Rotating the phone no longer jumps back pages

Other
• Fix • "1 other listener" no longer shows when you're the only one listening
• Improved • Selecting on the Downloads page includes kept ebooks
• Improved • New Discord invite link

v1.12.1•302
Beta 3

Narrated EPUBs
• New • Narrated EPUB3s on Audiobookshelf stream without downloading first, the same as on BookOrbit. Download one to listen offline
• New • Covers show a book and headphones badge on read aloud EPUB3 files
• Improved • Read along jumps straight to the sentence being read when you're far behind, and opening the book lands on it
• Fix • Narrated books with commas or special characters in their audio file names download and play

Reader
• New • Translate button when you select text. It sends the text to a translation app on your phone, Apple's translator on iPhone, or Google Translate or DeepL on the web (pick one in the Tt menu, Translate with)
• Fix • Pages no longer wobble in paged mode with the top bar pinned or in landscape

Stats
• New • BookOrbit stats: listening, reading or both, recent sessions, Year in Review, time of day, books finished by month, where you listen and read, and your habits
• New • When BookOrbit's time zone doesn't match your phone's, Stats offers to switch it so your days line up
• New • The stats card in a book's details now looks like BookOrbit's Your reading card, on both servers. On BookOrbit its arrow opens the book's Reading Log, with every session, progress over time and records

BookOrbit
• New • Notifications and achievements, from two new rows under your account in Settings. New notifications pop up while Absorb is open, and your notification settings save to BookOrbit
• New • Highlights sync with BookOrbit both ways
• New • Manage users and libraries on your server, share password links as a QR code, and set or change your password in Absorb
• New • Add, edit and delete listening sessions in a book's history
• Fix • Marking a book finished sticks, earlier finish dates save, and Remove from Continue works

Playback
• Fix • A car or headset pressing play with nothing loaded no longer restarts a book you finished somewhere else
• Fix • Switching to an account whose server can't be reached no longer hangs

Downloads
• Fix • Books with lots of files no longer overwhelm the server and knock Absorb offline while downloading
• Improved • With both the audiobook and its ebook downloaded, you pick which to remove

Other
• New • Betas now keep logs on from the start, so they're ready to send if something goes wrong. They stay on your device, and if you turn them off (Settings, Issues & Support) later betas leave them off
• New • New episode and release•day notifications on iPhone
• New • File info: format, codec, bitrate and size of a book's files, from the details sheet
• Improved • Collection and Smart Scope rows on Home show just their name, and Smart Scope rows get their own icon
• New • The What's new popup can be turned off (Settings, Issues & Support)

v1.12.1•301
Beta 2

Reader
• New • Page turns: Slide (the page follows your finger), Curl and Ripple, in the Tt menu under Page turn
• New • Tap zones: a 3x3 grid you can resize, with layouts to start from. Each square can turn back, turn forward, show the controls or do nothing (Tt menu, Tap zones)
• New • Paragraph spacing, and the controls now fade on their own after a few seconds (Tt menu)
• Improved • The Tt menu is grouped into sections, Search moved to the top bar, and scroll mode is smoother

BookOrbit
• Fix • Narrated EPUB3s download in seconds instead of crawling
• Fix • Narrated books no longer jump back to the start, read along follows the book's own narration, and edited chapters show up
• Fix • Library scans work

Playback
• Fix • The sleep timer's auto•rewind actually rewinds (433)
• Fix • A paused book no longer jumps back a minute or so when you resume (440)
• Fix • Playing past the last chapter the server knows about no longer freezes the app (428)

Downloads
• Improved • When a download can't be played and has to stream, Absorb tells you, and Home shows which books are downloaded (403)

Other
• Fix • Podcast playlists show on Discover again (413)
• Fix • Signing in to a server that never answers gives up after 20 seconds instead of spinning forever (322)

v1.12.1•300
Beta 1

EPUB3 narration (379)
• New • EPUB3 books that read themselves aloud play like audiobooks. Listen, read, or turn on read along to follow each sentence as it's spoken
• New • Highlight a sentence and tap Play from here. Opening the reader goes to what you're hearing, and reading ahead moves the audio to your page
• New • On Audiobookshelf the narration downloads before it plays. A queue stops before one that isn't downloaded instead of skipping it, and offers the download when you start the book before it
• New • Find in ebook and bookmark text use the book's own words, so no transcription is needed

Narrated EPUB3s on Audiobookshelf
Audiobookshelf doesn't support narrated EPUB3s on its own. Absorb fills in what it can, but a few things look different on the server:
• Note • Audiobookshelf sees these books as ebooks, so it shows no length for them: on the book, in playlists and on listening sessions. Your progress keeps the real length, and time listened still counts in your stats
• Note • The Audiobookshelf web app and other apps put them in Continue Reading even when you're listening. Absorb shows them in Continue Listening
• Note • The Audiobookshelf web app and its own apps can't play the narration, they only open the book to read

Reading and listening
• New • Keep reading and listening in sync (Settings, Transcription). Stop listening and the ebook moves to where you stopped, leave the reader and the audiobook moves to your page
• New • A Sync position button in a book's details when automatic sync is off, and a warning when a sync can't find your place
• New • Count reading time in stats, in the reader's Tt menu
• New • History tab in the reader's bookmarks, so you can get back to pages you left

Reader
• New • The top bar can show progress for the chapter, the book, or both (Tt menu)
• Fix • BookOrbit books open on the right page and no longer overwrite the spot saved on BookOrbit (299)
• Fix • Scroll mode no longer slides sideways while scrolling

Home
• New • Continue Reading uses the same big cards as Continue Listening, and now shows on BookOrbit too
• New • Option to open a book's details instead of playing when you tap it on Home (Settings, Library)

iPhone
• New • Siri: "Play [book] in Absorb", resume, pause, skip, chapters, sleep timer, bookmarks and "What's playing"

Other
• Fix • The Read button on an ebook•only book shows how far you've read
• Fix • No more dark gap under the search bar on the iPad library tabs

v1.12.0

Read along
• New • Read along: the narration is highlighted in the ebook as the audiobook plays, word by word or a sentence at a time, and the pages turn themselves. Turn pages freely and tap Back to narration to return
• New • Live transcript on the card for podcasts and books without an ebook, on streamed books too

Ebook reader
• New • Scroll mode, left•aligned text, and an option to keep the title bar on screen
• New • Picture•only ebooks open in the comic reader, which now has bookmarks
• New • The reader's player opens chapters, sleep timer, bookmarks, equalizer, cast and more
• Improved • Ebooks you've opened stay on the phone for offline reading, even after the audio download is deleted
• Fix • Books open where you left off after reading on the web or in another app

BookOrbit
• New • Sign in to BookOrbit servers, including SSO and magic links
• New • Smart Scopes, Book Dock, matching across every source, and book requests
• New • Filter the library by reading status

Playback
• New • Speed up to 5x, and on Android the loudness boost really raises the volume
• New • Choose what the notification, lock screen, Android Auto and CarPlay show on each line
• New • Keep the screen on in the player and car mode
• Fix • Streaming no longer gets stuck buffering, starting a download no longer cuts out the stream, and chapter jumps no longer restart the book
• Fix • Play picks up the newer spot from another device, and progress that fails to send is kept and sent later

Queue and series
• New • Adding to Absorbing asks whether it plays next or goes to the end
• New • The series sheet opens on the covers around your next book, with series stats and an up next button
• Fix • The series queue plays the actual next book and works past book 100

Car
• New • Car settings with sort options, and Collections and Playlists in the car library
• Fix • Android Auto no longer restarts the book when you switch to the radio

Downloads
• New • Download several books at once, play straight from Downloads even offline, and play downloads from the sign•in screen if you get signed out
• Fix • A failed download says why

Library
• New • New Collection and New Playlist buttons in the Lists tab, and search across bookmarks and highlights
• New • Sort series by total duration or last book added, and upload files into an existing book
• New • Find the start in the chapter editor listens around a marker for where the chapter really begins

Sign•in
• Improved • SSO sign•in returns to absorb://oauth. Server admins need to allow it under Settings, Authentication, Mobile redirect URIs (417)

Other
• New • A release notes link after an update, and a button background setting for the player card
• Fix • Book details use each library's cover shape and show every genre and tag, and authors without a photo no longer trip fail2ban (418)
• Fix • Settings sync no longer wakes the phone every 45 seconds in the background (409)

v1.11.1•296
Beta 12

Playback
• Fix • Picking a later chapter, or a spot set on the web, no longer starts the book over from the beginning
• Fix • A book whose audio file changed on the server plays the new file instead of getting stuck when you skip ahead

Downloads
• Fix • A download from another account keeps its reading spot on the phone instead of sending it to the server you're signed in to

Other
• Fix • Ebook•only books stay off the Absorbing page. Home's Continue row still opens them in the reader
• Fix • Reading positions saved offline sync on their own, and ones for a book the server no longer has stop retrying

v1.11.1•295
Beta 11

Ebook reader
• New • Scroll mode: read the book as one long page instead of turning pages. Turn it on in the Tt menu
• New • Picture•only ebooks, like illustrated kids' books, open in the comic reader so the pages fill the screen
• Fix • Books open where you left off after reading on the web, instead of back at the start
• Fix • Books where another app saved the reading spot no longer open to a blank page
• Fix • Pictures stay on their own page instead of leaving a strip on the next one
• Fix • Ebook•only books on the Continue card open the reader instead of trying to play

Read along
• New • Turn or scroll pages while read along runs, then tap Back to narration in the menu to return to the sentence being read
• Fix • The page no longer turns ahead and snaps back on sentences that end in an italic word

Comic reader
• New • Bookmarks, synced with BookOrbit for picture ebooks

Lists
• New • New Collection and New Playlist buttons in the Lists tab menu. Playlists can start empty, and an Audiobookshelf collection asks for its first book

BookOrbit
• New • Smart Scopes show in the Lists tab with a filter icon. Create, edit and delete them with the same rule builder as the web
• New • Filter the library by reading status
• Fix • Skimmed books show as Skimmed instead of Finished
• Fix • Scan Series checks every series and stops listing books you already have as missing
• Fix • Big collections and Smart Scopes show their full book count and load the rest as you scroll

iPhone
• Improved • Transcription and read along run on the GPU again on iOS older than 26.2, so they're back to full speed

Android
• Fix • The play button works again after the phone takes the audio away from a book paused for a while

Other
• Improved • The book details sheet uses each library's own cover shape

v1.11.1•293
Beta 10

iPhone
• Fix • Live transcription and read along no longer crash iPhones on iOS older than 26.2. They run on the CPU there for now, so they're a little slower
• Improved • Books made of several files play straight into the next file instead of pausing for a moment

Media controls
• New • Choose what the notification, lock screen, Android Auto and CarPlay show on each line, including book percentage, time left, narrator and series. Settings, Media Controls, Now playing text

BookOrbit
• New • Book Dock shows up as a library for accounts that can use it. Check and edit new files there, then add them to a library from the book page
• New • Matching searches every source at once and ranks the results, with a side by side compare where each field can be kept or taken from any result
• New • Book requests: ask for books, follow your requests, and as an admin approve or reject them, pick a release by hand and review downloads that need a check. On BookOrbit 3.4 an e•book and audiobook can be requested together
• Fix • Magic link sign•in works on servers with passwords turned off

Server admin
• New • Authentication page for setting up password and OpenID sign•in

Other
• Fix • Books download even when the server has no permanent download link for their files
• Fix • Pinch to zoom and panning work in the comic reader
• Fix • The live transcript no longer transcribes the same stretch over and over after a long pause in the narration
• Fix • Books deleted on the server leave the library grid right away
• Improved • The Goodreads button opens the book itself when its ISBN is known, instead of a search

v1.11.1•291
Beta 9

Sign•in
• Improved • SSO sign•in now returns to Absorb's own address, absorb://oauth, instead of the official app's. Your server admin needs to allow absorb://oauth under Settings, Authentication, Mobile redirect URIs before the next SSO sign•in. Anyone already signed in stays signed in (417)

Podcasts
• Fix • With the queue set to Show, an offline podcast now continues to its next downloaded episode even when that episode was never put on the queue

Read along
• Fix • Read along no longer stalls after a paragraph that ends on an ellipsis or a dash

Sleep timer
• Fix • The reset on pause and play option now catches every resume, not just the ones that landed on a timer tick (415)

Reader
• New • Alignment option in the reader controls: justified or left (416)

Library
• Fix • The book page shows every genre and tag instead of the first few
• Fix • Authors without a photo no longer get a photo request, which was tripping fail2ban and CrowdSec in front of some servers (418)

Look
• New • The keep screen on button in the More menu shows when it is on, and switches it off for this run when Settings has it on
• Fix • The one row widgets fit on launchers with short rows like Nothing and OnePlus

Other
• Fix • Settings sync no longer wakes the phone every 45 seconds while the app is in the background (409, thanks TerribleTurtle)

Look

Transcription

Car

Downloads

Other

Podcasts

Library
• Fix • Covers in sheets are no longer tiny in landscape

Downloads

Series

Series

Book details

Ebook reader

• New • A reader setting keeps the screen on while you read, on by default (384)

Playback

• Fix • A headset or car play press no longer restarts the episode that just finished and marks it unplayed (374)
• New • Playback speed goes up to 5x (389)
• Improved • On Android the loudness slider really boosts the volume now instead of just compressing it (388)

Podcasts

• New • Sort authors by date added, and narrators by number of books

Playback
• Fix • Playback no longer pauses every few minutes on Android Auto when the phone's Bluetooth link to the head unit blips (369)
• Fix • Absorb no longer starts playing on its own when opened from the widget cover, from Recents, or right after an update
• Fix • A streamed book no longer cuts out a few seconds after you resume when the server had closed its session
• Fix • Deleting another episode of the podcast you are listening to no longer stops playback

Connection
• Fix • Absorb picks the local server address at launch again when it answers, instead of staying on the remote one until you switch by hand

iOS
• Fix • A multi•file book no longer jumps back to the start after a pause or seek when the server session was recreated behind playback

Equalizer
• Fix • A band reads 0 instead of "•/+0"

Podcasts
• Fix • The "Downloading N episodes" toast no longer shows on every launch for episodes you had deleted
• Fix • An episode you reset no longer drags auto•download to the newest episodes; the window follows the episode you are actually on

v1.10.0•267
Beta 10

Large libraries
• Improved • The library loads a small first page, then bigger pages fetched ahead of your scroll
• Fix • A page that fails to load shows a retry instead of a spinner forever
• Fix • Searching a library past 10,000 books no longer floods the server
• Fix • Opening a series from a book shows that book right away, with a retry if the server is slow
• Improved • The authors tab loads in pages instead of fetching every author at once

Sync
• Fix • A position that loses to the server is replaced instead of retrying forever, and reopening the app no longer re•saves a paused position as fresh (iPhone and iPad drifting minutes apart)

Downloads
• Fix • Deleting a book no longer lets auto•download bring it straight back; it stays gone until you download it yourself

Settings sync
• New • The Absorbing order syncs between devices
• Fix • Auto•download switches and reader looks stay on the device they were set on

Book sheet
• Fix • Descriptions keep their paragraph breaks and show in full

iOS
• Fix • Absorb leaves the headset with an app you paused instead of taking it back
• Fix • The lock screen shows the right chapter after a headset or widget session moved the book along while the app was asleep, and keeps the cover when playback starts
• Improved • Covers are dropped from memory in the background, so a paused Absorb is less likely to be evicted and lose Now Playing to another app

v1.10.0•265
Beta 9

Lists
• Fix • The Lists tab is always there now, instead of showing up only once collections had loaded. If they can't be loaded you get a message and a retry rather than the tab quietly disappearing (362)
• Fix • Collections and the Lists tab no longer disappear on servers with very many collections

Shortcuts
• Fix • Setting a tab's hold to "Ask next time" now asks. On the Absorbing tab it played or paused instead
• Fix • The tab hold settings say Now Playing when classic wording is on

E•ink devices
• Fix • The Absorbing icon no longer disappears into the black selected pill

Podcasts
• Fix • Episodes stay in place in the queue • pausing a fresh one doesn't send it to the end, and a new one doesn't shove your current listen out of the top spot

Android Auto & CarPlay
• New • Add a toggle to start playback automatically when Android Auto or CarPlay connects
• Fix • Ebook•only books no longer show up in the Android Auto and CarPlay browse tree

iPad
• Fix • The share sheet actually appears now
• Fix • The library keeps refilling instead of stalling on a spinner until you scroll

Player
• Improved • Bigger cover on the full screen player, percent folded into the timestamps row
• Improved • Sharper covers on the player cards

Settings
• New • Search jumps to and highlights the matching setting
• New • Lock screen skip icons are explained in the iOS skip settings

Ebook reader
• Fix • Text selection no longer leaves the ebook stuck between two pages
• Fix • Find in audiobook no longer lands in the wrong chapter
• Fix • Finding an ebook spot before audio has started uses your saved listening position
• New • Look up a selected word without leaving the app

Series
• Fix • Up Next shows the real next book in the series

Widgets
• Fix • Widgets stay wired up correctly after a reboot

iOS
• Improved • Bluetooth and lock screen controls are much more reliable

v1.9.3•248
Beta 8

Stats
• Fix • A crash when Android relaunched the app in the background no longer splits listening into dozens of duplicate sessions that inflate your listening stats (352)

Search
• Fix • Searching a library with more than 10,000 books now finds the newest books too, in the app and in Android Auto (349)

Transcription
• New • Transcription runs faster: a book's language is detected once and remembered instead of every single time, and a voice•detection pass that cost more than the transcribing itself is gone
• New • A new Base model (about 57 MB) sits between Tiny and Small, and the app picks the best downloaded model for each job on its own • the quickest one when the book's ebook supplies the exact words, the most accurate one you have when the transcript stands alone. Download one or all three and the picking takes care of itself
• Fix • Choosing Keep reading after finding your spot in the audiobook no longer opens the full screen player over the e•reader
• New • When a book has an ebook, transcribing a bookmark can swap Whisper's text for the ebook's exact words • a confident match means a word•perfect note (toggle in the transcribe popup)
• Fix • Transcribing bookmarks and finding your position now work for books downloaded to a custom Android folder, instead of asking you to download the book first
• Fix • Jumping between the ebook and audiobook could give up when a book spells out its chapter numbers ("Thirty•Nine" was mistaken for "Nine") or reuses chapter names between characters
• Fix • Transcribing a bookmark, finding your spot in the ebook and exporting a clip could start up to half a minute before the bookmark on MP3 files

Reading
• Fix • Very large illustrated ebooks crashed the app when opened
• New • Tap a highlight to change its color, add or edit its note, share it as a quote card, find that spot in the audiobook, or remove it
• Fix • A highlight could draw a few lines away from its own text when the book opened, most often on a device the highlight synced to
• Fix • The reader's settings sheet can now be swiped closed

Tips
• New • Tips & Hidden Features in Settings catches up on everything recent: transcription, jumping between formats, quote sharing, clip export, volume•key page turns and more

Bookmarks
• Fix • A bookmark note synced through the server now comes back apart as title and note on your other devices, instead of one long title
• Fix • Opening a book's bookmarks now pulls the latest from the server even when the book isn't playing
• Fix • Listen on a bookmark now plays on very long single•file audiobooks instead of erroring
• Fix • Podcast bookmarks now stay with the episode you made them on, and Listen, Transcribe and Export clip work on them. They travel between your devices in the settings backup, since the server has nowhere to keep an episode's bookmarks
• New • The bookmark button in Android Auto and CarPlay now works on podcast episodes

E•ink devices
• New • An e•ink mode under Settings > Appearance
    • light flat monochrome look, no animations or ripples, dark covers lifted so they keep detail on e•paper, and the live server connection rests to save battery
• New • Physical page•turn buttons (like the Boox Palma's side button) flip pages in the reader. Outside the reader screen, they play or pause the current book

Shortcuts
• New • Hold any tab in the bottom bar to pick what it does
    • Set it once per tab, or pick "Always show menu" to get the list every time (all of it under Settings > Advanced)

Podcasts
• Fix • Up Next now shows the episode you're partway through plus the next one waiting in that show, for every show you've started, instead of only episodes already started
• Fix • The Finished filter on the Episodes tab lists your finished episodes instead of always coming back empty

Book stats
• New • Listening stats at the bottom of a book's details: your time, sessions, and first and last listen. Admins also see everyone on the server • who started it, who finished it, and how long they spent

Backup & sync
• Fix • Restoring a backup that turns settings sync on now asks whether the server's copy or the backup wins, instead of quietly pushing the older backup to your other devices

Covers
• New • The full•screen cover view closes with a tap or a swipe, not just the X button

Beta 7

Transcription

• New • Turn audio bookmarks into text, fully on your device. Pick how much to transcribe 15s • 2min, then fix it up in the bookmark sheet
    • Enable it under settings > Advanced > Transcription and download a model. The Tiny Whisper model is about 31 MB and has been working great for me in testing. 

Find your spot between audiobook and ebook

• Both need the audiobook downloaded, transcription enabled, and an EPUB ebook file on the book.
• New • While listening, Pause your audiobook and tap Find position in ebook. The ebook will open after a small bit of audio gets transcribed and then searched across the ebook file for a match. 
• New • While reading, highlight some text and tap the headphones button at the bottom. The app will compare and find that spot in the audio book and start playing it. You can choose to stay in the e•reader or go to the player screen. 
• If a spot can’t be matched confidently by Absorb, nothing moves. 

Share quotes

• New • Share an ebook Highlight or an audiobook bookmark•note as a quote rendered over the book cover
    • A few settings to get your share image just right

Ebook Reader

• Find all of your highlights from every book in the All Bookmarks page in the settings. 
• Reading an ebook uses less battery

Settings sync

• Keep settings in sync across devices through your own WebDAV server. Settings > Backup and sync
    • Requires the folder you want to store the .json file in to already be created

iOS

• Lock screen controls now use your own skip amounts instead of always 10 and 30
    • Apple only has lock screen icons for 5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 and 90 • any other amount shows as a "+" but still skips what you picked

v1.9.3•240
Beta 6

Playback
• Play from your headphones, the widget, the lock screen or AA/CP starts right away instead of waiting on the server, whether the book is downloaded or streamed
• Starting a downloaded book from headphones or the widget with the app closed is much faster, instead of 5 to 10 seconds, and works with no signal at all
• Pressing play in the app after a longer pause checks for progress made on another device before starting, and never jumps once audio is playing
• The session•start rewind is applied before playback begins, so no more burst of audio and then a jump on a fresh start
• Starting a downloaded book from a bookmark or chapter starts where you tapped instead of jumping ahead to the server position

Headphones
• Headsets that report a play press as "pause" now resume when paused

Widget
• The home screen widget shows paused when a call or another app interrupts playback, instead of counting on

Fix
• Scrolling a dense library grid, or any screen full of covers, no longer crashes • the app now builds on Flutter 3.47, which also makes scrolling smoother

v1.9.3•237
Beta 5

Scan Series
• Upcoming Releases is now Scan Series: a quick scan for upcoming books, or a deep scan that also finds missing books across every series
• Scans learn which series are finished and skip them, so repeat scans take a fraction of the time
• Get a notification the day a tracked book releases
• Long•press to select several books and request or remove them together
• Link a series by pasting its Audible ASIN when it can't be matched, and a scan report shows what was checked, skipped, or unmatched
• The skipped list opens its actions with a tap and supports multi•select
• Series scanning now works for Audible regions the metadata service doesn't cover, by falling back to the US catalog

Cross•device sync
• Progress made on other devices catches up when you come back to the app, even for events missed while it was in the background
• The paused player follows along too, so the card and resume point match where you left off elsewhere
• Books finished on another device leave Absorbing right away
• Progress reaches the server every 20 seconds instead of every minute

New
• Cover size setting: small, medium, or large covers across the library, with tablets scaling to match and labels growing with the covers
• Sort podcast episodes by publish date, title, season, episode number, or file name, in either direction
• Reset or extend the sleep timer with a headphone button press during the wind•down
• French language option, plus the latest community translations
• Remove a book's cover and leave it with none
• Pick several books on home or in the library and quick match, mark, or delete them at once
• Admin: scan schedules, metadata source ordering, a server logs screen, and podcast episode limits
• Admin: every Audible region can be picked as a library's metadata provider, plus custom providers from your server

Improved
• The generated title card shows on the home shelves and no longer gets cut off on small covers
• Bookmark, history, and chapter times show at your playback speed
• Progress numbers stay readable on tinted home cards

Fix
• A book's percentage on the server no longer drifts away from your actual listening position
• Now Playing no longer sticks on the last chapter when rereading a finished book
• Streams no longer cut out for a few seconds every hour
• A stuck player no longer banks hours you never listened or drags your place in a book backwards
• Chromecast reconnects after a background drop instead of dying for good
• The companion ebook downloads with the audiobook, so Read works offline

v1.9.3•233
Beta 3

New
• Short notifications can lower the volume instead of pausing
• Queue auto•download for a series, show, playlist, or collection
• Playlists and collections keep the next books downloaded as you listen
• Delete books and episodes from the server, keeping or removing the files
• Daily, weekly, and monthly listening goals run at once, with higher targets
• Pick which day the week starts on
• Subscribe to a podcast without new episodes filling up Absorbing

Improved
• Auto•download list shows real names and collapses into a dropdown
• Queue management uses more of the screen
• GitHub release updater downloads the smaller APK made for your device (updating to this build still gets the universal APK, later ones get the build for your device)
• Auto•delete settings say clearly that only items finished in Absorb are deleted
• Swipe actions need a longer swipe and buzz before they fire
• Playing within five minutes of a sleep timer undoes its rewind

Fix
• Library switching and the Podcasts tab work when starting offline
• Playback no longer blips when a login session refreshes
• Covers load sooner in the full•screen player
• Books finished on another device leave Absorbing; replayed ones stay
• Queue auto•download actually downloads
• Queued books resume where you left off after an auto•advance
• End of chapter sleep timer stops at the chapter end, including the last one
• Updating from an older version gets an APK that installs on any phone

v1.9.3•227
Beta 2

New
• Audiobookshelf 2.36 support with password changes and signed•in device management
• More library filters, sorting, and listening•session browsing
• Book previews and admin controls for explicit/abridged metadata and file paths
• Card scrubber modes
• variable bitrate MP3 seeking option (Android)
• Up Next and New podcast episode filters
• Per•account server editing with custom headers
• Book start and finish dates can be edited from book details

Improved
• Account switching now reloads the correct library and stats behind a loading screen
• Backups now restore per•library settings and the podcast tab correctly
• Android Auto shows when the next book is loading
• Android Auto search now finds partial book titles
• Server admins can see when an Audiobookshelf update is available

Fix
• Sessions stay signed in through token rotation and temporary connection problems
• Audio restarts automatically if a server stream cuts out
• Finished books stay out of Absorbing unless manually added or replayed
• Skipping past the final chapter finishes the book
• Playback, previews, episode downloads, and editor seeking are more reliable
• Pausing during the sleep timer fade no longer triggers the sleep rewind
• Home opens the book library correctly when the podcast tab is enabled
• Android Auto no longer resumes downloaded books from an older position while offline
• Author grids no longer have extra space between rows

v1.9.3•220
Beta 1

New
• Quick Match in Edit Details for admins
• Combined playlist and collection editing
• Shareable sign•in links and QR codes for easier account setup

Improved
• Absorb toasts throughout the app

Fix
• More reliable downloads, including multi•file books
• Stable covers and colors during artwork updates
• Live updates with subdirectory server URLs
• Login and token improvements
• Android background podcast checks
• Streamed books no longer go silent or jump back after progress sync
• CarPlay no longer loads while disconnected
• Better handling for malformed server URLs

v1.9.2

New
• Read ebooks right in the app, download them for offline reading, and turn pages with your volume buttons
• A dedicated Podcasts tab with an Episodes view, new•episode notifications, and admin tools to edit shows and bulk•download episodes
• The Android home screen widget resizes from a tile to a full player with live progress; iOS gets a new widget too
• Pick your own app color, or match the book cover, with flat light and dark themes
• A customizable stats page with Year in Review
• In•app admin area for libraries, server settings, stats, uploads, and cleaning up missing items
• Set cover shape and skip amounts per library, with optional long•skip buttons
• Collections and playlists get their own Lists tab, with bulk•add and inline playback
• Export a bookmark as an audio clip
• AirPlay button on iPhone and iPad
• Custom download folder picker on Android, for play store release
• Long•press shortcuts on the bottom bar
• See your listening sessions for any book or podcast
• Lock the screen in portrait from Settings

Improved
• Search is more forgiving of typos, word order, and punctuation
• Now playing shows the chapter as the title everywhere • lock screen, notification, Android Auto, CarPlay, and widgets
• Android Auto's Continue tab shows your downloaded books right away, in listening order, even offline
• Backups now include ebook highlights and notes

Fix
• Heavy battery use while paused
• SSO login behind a proxy that needs custom headers
• Falls back to the remote server when the local address stops answering
• The equalizer no longer goes silent after switching books or updating the app
• The app no longer opens a second time in your recent apps when you tap the notification
• Downloads are more reliable and no longer get stuck in the queue
• Multi•file downloaded audiobooks no longer reset to the start or block seeking
• The library fills the whole screen on tablets now
• Lockscreen, notification, and headset controls no longer stop responding after background playback finishes
• The progress bar no longer overshoots your actual position while paused
• Installing an update while listening no longer freezes the app on launch or leaves the widget stuck on playing

v1.9.1•216
Beta 8

New
• Upload right from Absorb, with optional automatic metadata matching for book uploads
• Admins can add podcast shows right from library search and open a show's server settings from its overflow menu
• See running scans, metadata jobs, and other server activity from Server Admin
• See listening sessions for books and podcasts

Improved
• The 4x1 widget is tidier, with just the cover, title, and controls, plus a spinner while playback starts

Fix
• Android Auto loads the library and downloads even when Absorb wasn't opened first
• Supplementary ebooks in audiobooks•only libraries open instead of saying there is no ebook file
• Rotation lock stays applied after reopening the app and leaving car mode
• Duplicate book detail sheets no longer stack up
